BCI Chief Defends Against Resignation Calls Amid Allegations

Bar Council of India (BCI) Chairman Manan Kumar Mishra has stated he will resign if financial irregularities are proven, responding to demands for his removal. The co-chairman of the BCI alleged fund diversion and nepotism in appointments, leading to calls for Mishra's resignation. A plea has also been filed in the Supreme Court seeking Mishra's removal. Mishra has challenged accusers to present evidence of financial wrongdoing.
